```
private fun findExpressionEnd(value: String, start: Int): Int {
    var i = start
    var depth = 1
    while (i < value.length) {
        when (value[i]) {
            '{' -> depth++
            '}' -> {
                depth--
                if (depth == 0) return i
            }
            '\\' -> i++ // skip escaped char? Data binding doesn't use backslash escapes in XML.

        i++
    }
    return -1
}
```

```
private fun scanForUnescaped(context: XmlContext, attribute: Attr, expr: String, exprOffset: Int, quote: Char?) {
    var i = 0
    while (i < expr.length) {
        val c = expr[i]
        when {
            c == '&' -> {
                // check if start of valid entity reference
                val end = expr.indexOf(';', i)
                if (end == -1 || !isValidEntityReference(expr.substring(i, end + 1))) {
                    report(context, attribute, exprOffset + i, c)
                }
                i = if (end == -1) i + 1 else end + 1
            }
            c == '<' || c == '>' -> report(context, attribute, exprOffset + i, c)
            c == quote -> report(context, attribute, exprOffset + i, c)
        }
        i++
    }
}
```
